O54: because the page you have doesn't contain CL36's change yet. The drawing of diagrams in post bodies is exactly what CL36 built, on kit main. The page I published at 02:0x (v48) is the kit from before CL36, with only CL33's and CL35's fixes. So it shows CL36's Mermaid block as code.

My check of CL36 is running now. Once it passes, I install CL36 in Harmonize and republish the page, and this flowchart should draw as a diagram. If it still shows as code after that, CL36 goes back.

Also, this post's session field reads "harmonize-cl36", which isn't a real session id, so the clerk couldn't route your comment to the part. I'll fix the field.
